mechanisms.compare:copy: no — changes which value is live
mechanisms.dat:width: yes — vary a data symbol's declared width
mechanisms.domain:integer: no — changes the type of an expression tree
mechanisms.guard:early: yes — a wrapping `if` becomes a guard with an early exit, with the value signed
mechanisms.localtype: yes — vary a local's or a parameter's declared type
mechanisms.pointer:named: no — introduces a binding that changes CSE
mechanisms.symbol:addr: yes — an address as a value becomes a symbol reference

note: Closures per mechanism pass, over a band. A mechanism that closes nothing is a measured zero. The mechanisms no text pass can express are listed in `mechanisms` — that is the finding, not a TODO.
